title: Salesforce Automation QA
description:
**Core Requirements**

* **Technology:** Salesforce Automation QA(Playwright, Salesforce, Apex testing)
* **Experience:** 3-5 years
* **Duration:** 6 Months
* **Working Time:-** 6:30 AM - 3:30 PM IST.

**Critical Deployment Notes**

* **Compliance:** For the background verification (BGV) process, PAN card and Aadhaar card of the proposed resources will be required.
* The **UAN number** is required for selected candidates..

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience in QA Automation, with strong exposure to

Salesforce testing.

* Strong hands-on experience in test automation, preferably within Salesforce-based

applications and enterprise web applications.

* Good understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud,

Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, custom objects, workflows, flows, triggers, and

integrations.

* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright using JavaScript/TypeScript for UI automation.
* Experience with Selenium and familiarity with Salesforce-specific automation tools such as

Provar/Copado is desirable.

* Experience in mobile automation using Appium and WebdriverIO.
* Strong understanding of API testing and automation using REST/SOAP APIs.
* Experience configuring and executing automated tests through CI/CD pipelines, preferably

using GitHub Actions or similar DevOps tools.

* Exposure to performance testing using K6 and interpretation of performance test results.
* Exposure to AI-driven QA tools, AI-assisted test generation, test optimization, defect analysis,

or GenAI-based testing practices.

* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern QA practices.
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively

with technical and business stakeholders.

* A strong learning mindset, adaptability, and enthusiasm to grow in AI, Salesforce, and

Automation Engineering.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Playwright (JS/TS) for

Salesforce applications and integrations.

* Define and execute QA strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and automation approaches for

Salesforce implementations across Sales, Service, Experience, and Marketing Clouds.

* Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, and

other relevant automation tools.

* Develop and execute functional, regression, integration, UAT, API, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, and business

processes.

* Perform Apex testing, including validation of triggers, classes, batch jobs, and associated

business logic.

* Write and execute SOQL/SOSL queries to validate Salesforce data and test results.
* Perform data validation using Salesforce Data Loader, Workbench, and other data

management tools.

* Develop automated tests for REST/SOAP APIs and validate data, responses, integrations, and

error scenarios.

* Configure and maintain test execution within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated

regression suites are integrated into deployment workflows.

* Perform mobile application automation using Appium/WebdriverIO where required.
* Conduct performance and load testing using K6, identify bottlenecks, and communicate

performance findings.

* Explore and implement AI-driven testing approaches, including AI-assisted test case

generation, test data generation, defect analysis, and automation optimization.

* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira/Azure DevOps, ensuring timely

resolution and retesting.

* Maintain test cases and execution results using Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or equivalent test

management tools.

* Collaborate closely with Salesforce Developers, Administrators, Architects, Business

Analysts, and business users to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test

coverage.

* Communicate effectively with client technical partners to clarify requirements, discuss

defects, and align on implementation and release expectations.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-

ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, test

efficiency, and release quality.

**PRIMARY SKILLS**

* Salesforce: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Custom Objects
* UI Automation: Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript, Selenium
* Mobile Automation: Appium, WebdriverIO
* API Testing: REST/SOAP API testing and automation
* Salesforce Testing: Functional, Regression, Integration, UAT, End-to-End
* Salesforce Development Validation: Apex Triggers, Classes, Batch Jobs
* Salesforce Data Validation: SOQL, SOSL, Data Loader, Workbench
* CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD platforms
* Performance Testing: K6
* Test Management: Jira, Xray, Zephyr
* Automation Framework: Framework design, maintenance, reusable test components, test data

management

* AI/GenAI: AI-assisted QA, test case/script generation, defect analysis, intelligent test automation
* Programming/Scripting: JavaScript/TypeScript; basic programming and scripting concepts
* Version Control: Git/GitHub
* Agile/Scrum: Sprint-based QA and DevOps practices

Secondary Skills(If Any)

* Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX) and Salesforce CLI.
* Exposure to Provar, Copado or other Salesforce-specific testing/DevOps tools.
* Knowledge of Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI or equivalent API testing tools.
* Exposure to JMeter or other performance testing tools.
* Basic understanding of SOQL/SOSL optimization and Salesforce governor limits.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Exposure to Docker/containerized test execution.
* Knowledge of test reporting, dashboards, and QA metrics.
* Familiarity with Page Object Model, BDD, data-driven testing, and modular automation

frameworks.

* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, LLM-based tools, prompt engineering, or AI agents for software

testing.

* Experience working in client-facing or consulting environments.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related

discipline.

* Equivalent technical qualifications with relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Certifications Required(If Any)

* Salesforce Certified Administrator – preferred.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I – desirable.
* Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder – desirable.
* ISTQB Certified Tester / Test Automation Engineer – preferred.
* Relevant Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or AI/GenAI certifications are an added advantage.
* Certifications are preferred rather than mandatory, provided the candidate demonstrates

strong hands-on expertise

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent, Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Salesforce Automation QA: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: App Security Specialist
description:
**\#Cyber Security Experts\#**


1\. Job Title : App Security Specialist 2\. Job Summary : Serve as an experienced application security specialist focusing on mobile security and dynamic application security testing within a hybrid work model. Apply deep technical expertise to secure complex mobile applications reduce vulnerabilities and align security posture with organizational goals while collaborating closely with development and operations teams in a day shift role without travel requirements. 3\. Experience : 8 \- 10 years 4\. Required Skills : Technical Skills: Mobile Security Dynamic Application Sec Test Domain Skills: 5\. Nice to have skills : Domain Skills: 6\. Technology : Custom Service 7\. Shift : Day 8\. Responsibilities : \- Lead security assessments of mobile applications by planning and executing dynamic application security testing activities that identify exploitable weaknesses across multiple releases and platforms ensuring robust protection of customer data and business services. \- Conduct comprehensive dynamic application security tests on mobile and web components by configuring appropriate tooling crafting test scenarios and analyzing runtime behavior to reveal security defects that static reviews may miss. \- Collaborate with product engineering teams by translating complex security vulnerabilities into clear technical remediation guidance that fits existing architecture and sprint plans thereby accelerating secure software delivery. \- Provide actionable risk analysis by prioritizing identified mobile security issues based on impact and likelihood enabling stakeholders to focus on the most critical remediation work that strengthens overall security posture. \- Oversee integration of dynamic application security testing into continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines by working closely with DevOps teams to automate recurring tests and optimize feedback loops for developers. \- Drive security design reviews for new mobile features by evaluating authentication mechanisms data storage practices cryptographic usage and network communication flows to ensure alignment with internal standards and industry regulations. \- Coordinate vulnerability management activities by tracking findings from dynamic tests and mobile security reviews managing aging defects and supporting teams in verifying and closing remediation actions ahead of key releases. \- Guide secure coding practices within development squads by sharing best practice patterns for input validation session management secure storage and error handling that directly reduce common classes of mobile application exploits. \- Perform root cause analysis on recurring security issues by examining code patterns configuration baselines and development processes so that systemic improvements can be implemented to prevent similar vulnerabilities from resurfacing. \- Engage with cross functional stakeholders such as architecture compliance and operations teams by presenting distilled security insights that connect technical risk to business impact and societal trust in digital products. \- Maintain and update specialized mobile security and dynamic application security testing tools by tuning rules improving test coverage and documenting repeatable procedures so teams benefit from consistent and reliable security checks. \- Research emerging mobile threats and evolving attack techniques by reviewing industry reports and security advisories then adapting test strategies and internal guidance so the company remains resilient against modern adversaries. \- Support incident response teams when application related security events occur by quickly reproducing issues confirming exploitation paths and helping define corrective actions that restore normal operations and protect end users. Qualifications \- Demonstrate advanced hands on experience in mobile application security across multiple platforms by applying deep knowledge of secure architectures secure data handling and exploit techniques to real world products. \- Exhibit strong proficiency in dynamic application security testing methodologies by effectively using specialized tools and designing custom test cases that simulate realistic attacker behavior against complex applications. \- Apply broad understanding of secure software development practices by collaborating with developers who use modern programming languages and frameworks ensuring security controls are baked into design and implementation. \- Bring practical familiarity with hybrid work collaboration by using digital communication channels and documentation tools to coordinate security activities efficiently with distributed teams operating in a day shift. \- Utilize solid analytical and communication skills by explaining technical findings to both engineering and nontechnical stakeholders in a concise manner that enables fast decision making about risk and remediation.

title: Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for a **motivated and skilled Flutter Developer with 1\+ years of hands\-on experience** to join our development team. The candidate should have strong practical experience in **Flutter development, REST API integration, state management, Firebase, mobile application architecture, and app deployment**.

* Build **responsive, user\-friendly, and pixel\-perfect UI** based on UI/UX designs.
* Integrate **REST APIs** and handle JSON data effectively.
* Implement state management using **BLoC, Cubit, Provider**, or similar frameworks.
* Integrate Firebase services including:
* Firebase Authentication
* Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
* Firebase Crashlytics
* Implement secure authentication and user management.
* Integrate **third\-party SDKs, APIs, and services** as required.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues and crashes.
* Optimize application performance, stability, and responsiveness.

* Write clean, scalable, reusable, and maintainable Dart/Flutter code.

**Must\-Have Skills**

* **1\+ years of hands\-on Flutter development experience**
* Strong knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**
* Good understanding of **Flutter widgets and responsive UI**
* Experience with **REST API integration**
* Good knowledge of **JSON parsing and API error handling**
* Hands\-on experience with **BLoC / Cubit / Provider** or similar state management
* Experience with **Git and GitHub/GitLab**
* Basic to good knowledge of **Firebase**
* Understanding of **Android build and release processes**
* Knowledge of **mobile application architecture and reusable components**
* Ability to independently **debug and resolve technical issues**

Good to Have

* Experience with **iOS development and App Store deployment**
* Experience with **Firebase Cloud Messaging and push notifications**
* Knowledge of **Dio, Retrofit**, or similar API clients
* Experience integrating payment gateways such as **Razorpay, Cashfree, or Stripe**
* Knowledge of local storage such as **SharedPreferences, Hive, or SQLite**
* Experience with **Google Maps and location\-based services**
* Basic knowledge of **Node.js, Express.js, or MongoDB**
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs and APIs

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong **problem\-solving and analytical skills**.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Comfortable working in a **fast\-paced development environment**.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on **real\-world Flutter applications**
* Exposure to **modern mobile development technologies**
* Collaborative and supportive work environment
* Opportunities for **continuous learning and career growth**
* Competitive salary based on **skills and experience**

Key Hiring Criteria

**Flutter \+ Dart \| REST APIs \| BLoC/Cubit/Provider \| Firebase \| Git \| Android/iOS \| Debugging \| App Deployme**

title: iOS Developer
description:
**Company:** Fusion My Business

**Domain:** Fintech \| POS

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a skilled iOS Developer with 2–4 years of experience to build and scale a

production\-grade iOS application.

The role involves developing a mission\-critical merchant platform that supports:

 Merchant onboarding and KYC

 Card payments \& Tap\-to\-Pay on iPhone

 POS \& inventory management

 Payouts, analytics \& finance tools

You will collaborate closely with Product, Backend, QA, and Design teams to deliver a secure, high\-performance, and delightful merchant experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift

 Build high\-performance fintech \& POS workflows (payments, orders, refunds, reports)

 Implement secure APIs for authentication, transactions, payments, and dashboards

 Integrate payment SDKs such as Stripe, Apple Pay, Tap\-to\-Pay, and card readers

 Handle real\-time data, background synchronization, and offline\-first workflows

 Apply MVVM / Clean Architecture principles

 Write and maintain unit tests, UI tests, and performance tests

 Debug crashes, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks

 Work closely with Product \& UX teams to deliver pixel\-perfect UI

 Support App Store releases, updates, and version upgrades

**Required Skills**

 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in iOS application development

 Strong proficiency in Swift

 Experience with UIKit and/or SwiftUI

 Solid understanding of REST APIs \& JSON

 Knowledge of Apple Human Interface Guidelines

 Experience integrating payment SDKs or fintech APIs

 Local data storage using Core Data / SQLite / Realm

 Experience with Push Notifications, deep linking, and background services

 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and App Store deployments

**Good to Have**

 Experience in Fintech, POS, Payments, or Banking applications

 Hands\-on experience with Stripe, Square, or SumUp\-style platforms

 Knowledge of security, encryption, tokenization \& PCI compliance

 Experience integrating Bluetooth devices (card readers, printers, kiosks)

**Why Join Fusion My Business**

 Build a UK\-focused Fintech \& POS platform

 Work on real payment flows and financial products

 Opportunity to grow into Senior Engineer / Tech Lead / Architect

 Exposure to global merchants and high\-scale transaction systems

 Product\-driven culture with real ownership and impact
